name: Kagami no Naka no Princess -Love Palace-
original_name: 鏡の中のプリンセス Love Palace
source:
An ordinary office clerk... stepped into a mysterious world?!

"We were waiting, Princess".

After breaking your grandma's hand mirror, you accidentally entered a different dimension. Out of the blue you've become a princess, and you must choose a partner!

Before your eyes, you meet a colorful cast of knights, nobles and servants that live in the palace. And among all the confusion, you find a helping hand....

Will you become involved in a love battle among other dimension?

[Source: [url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/fantasy/mirrorlp/index.html]Voltage[/url]]
translation:
一个普通的办公室文员……踏入了一个神秘的世界？！

“我们正在等待，公主”。

打碎了奶奶的手镜后，你不小心进入了异次元。突然你变成了公主，你必须选择一个伴侣！

在你的眼前，你会遇到居住在宫殿中的一群色彩斑斓的骑士、贵族和仆人。在所有的困惑中，你找到了援助之手……

你会卷入异次元的爱情大战吗？

[来源：[url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/fantasy/mirrorlp/index.html]电压[/url]]
